# A book kept in CAD holding securities a prices file cannot price on its own.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets:Nasdaq AMZN holding NASDAQ:AMZN, Assets:Neo
# AMZN holding NEO:AMZN, and Assets:SHOP holding TSX:SHOP, with no transactions
# and no prices. A prices file giving `AMZN:` cannot say which of the two AMZN
# it means, and one giving `SHOP:` cannot say which currency the price is in.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_rates_file_prices_gnucash_reports_for_the_run_only.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc CDR"
	namespace: "NEO"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 commodity SHOP
	mnemonic: "SHOP"
	fullname: "Shopify Inc"
	namespace: "TSX"
	fraction: 10000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Nasdaq AMZN
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Neo AMZN
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NEO"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
2026-01-01 open Assets:SHOP
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "TSX"
	commodity.mnemonic: "SHOP"
